playground.title: Editor
playground.subtitle: Choose a language and run code. No account needed.
playground.empty: Run your code to see the result here.
playground.limits: 30 KB source · 64 KB input/output · 6 runs/min · Results expire after 5 minutes. Each language has its own browser draft.

errors.invalid: Check the source, input and selected language.

playground.waiting: Your code runs in the server sandbox.
playground.stale: Code or input changed. This output belongs to the previous run.
playground.noDiagnostics: Compiler and runtime diagnostics appear here.

playground.fileFailed: Could not read the source file.
